content.comment_body: Hello, please assist me. I am [user_name]. My [product_name] screen currently shows only three menus: Setup, Network, and Diagnostics. I am not sure how to perform a factory reset. Any assistance would be appreciated. Thank you. [Split from [product_name], Factory Reset.]

As mentioned previously, if you have a [product_name] standard model, you can access administrator mode with the correct password to enter the extended menu. If you have not changed the password, it is usually set to "[product_name]" (without the quotes).

analysis.insight_summary: The user has limited access to menu options on a [product_name] device and cannot find the factory reset function. Another user explains that extended features require administrator mode, accessible via a password, highlighting confusion about navigating device settings and locating key functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects easy access to all device features, including factory reset, directly from the main menu and without needing to search for administrative credentials.
